name: Tumbled Crystal
summary: Tumbled Crystals are strange blue stones found by Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti. Their unusual finish has drawn the company’s interest and Revilgaz’s attention.

sections.title: Blue Stone
sections.body: In Booty Bay, Kebok answers a Venture Co. challenge to Revilgaz, the notorious pirate, his own way: theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti have been finding blue crystals in their mines, and Kebok wants their samples. Kebok judges that the company plans to use the stones as fuel or a catalyst, though he knows little more. The samples are to be sent to Head Chemist Gigglefont for study.

faq.answer: A Tumbled Crystal is a strange blue stone found by Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti.

faq.q: Where do the crystals come from?
faq.answer: Venture Co. geologists find Tumbled Crystals in their mines near Lake Nazferiti in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Revilgaz want the crystals?
faq.answer: Revilgaz told Kebok to deal with the Venture Co. his own way, and Kebok chose to steal the blue stones their geologists prize. Kebok suspects they may be fuel or a catalyst.
Kebok in Booty Bay asks you to bring him Tumbled Crystals for Revilgaz.
Head Chemist Gigglefont is to receive the Tumbled Crystal samples for study.

angles.text: As a miner, you can see why the Venture Co. geologists prize unusual stones found in their workings.
